correctness.rationale: For regular n>=3, polygon-intersection of the vertex-diameter disk is disk area pi/4 minus exactly two disjoint adjacent circular caps, giving the exact mean ((pi/2-pi/n)/sin(2pi/n)+1/2). The disk condition cos(theta-2pi j/n)>=||x|| makes depth an equally spaced circular arc count, with sharp discrepancy 1/n attained at side midpoints. Coupling uniform n-gon area to uniform circumdisk at total variation delta_n and the pi-Lipschitz sin² CDF yields the stated limit and finite-n Kolmogorov bound. Independently evaluated mean via both polygon cap area and closed form for n=3,5,8,18. These agree; the proof provides universal n and boundary cases.
